Subject: SUP-07 cold plate SI-CP-0007 rev A — information request

Hello Oscorp team,

To complete our review of your packet for SI-CP-0007, please send the following:

1. 1.capa — your documented corrective-action (CAPA) procedure.
2. 2.ctq_cpk — Cpk results for each CTQ (base thickness, port bore, mounting-hole pitch), with the study data behind them.
3. 3.grr — Gage R&R results, as % of tolerance, for the gauges used on each CTQ.
4. 5.lot_trace — evidence of lot or serial traceability to raw material, such as a sample traceability record.
5. 8.subtier_certs — current certificates on file for your critical sub-tier supplier.

Thank you.

Stark Industries Supplier Quality — Pepper Potts

audit_plan.question: capability_study.md §1.1 only claims the process holds tolerance. Ask for the raw measurement data and Cpk calculations for base thickness, port bore and mounting-hole pitch against the rfq.md limits.
msa.md §1.1 only claims suitable repeatability. Ask to see Gage R&R studies for each CTQ gauge and the % of tolerance results, and check calibration status of those gauges.
quality_manual.md §1.5 says shipments link to incoming material batches. Trace one shipped lot back to the raw material certificate and confirm the records exist at lot or serial level.
